visualCharacteristics: Light 2-column grid of article cards. Each card has an eyebrow/category label, a thumbnail image, a title, a short description, and a 'Find out'/'Learn more' CTA link. Some cards are text-only (no image).
contentPattern: Container block, one row per card: optional image cell + text cell (eyebrow + title + description + CTA).
usage: Use for an 'editor's picks' style grid of article teasers.
